subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo & pricing \u0014 startup / committed-use options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-12T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo & pricing  startup / committed-use options

Hi Sam  great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap from today's discovery call:
- Primary use case: in-product chat + short generation for workflow automation (customer support + snippets).
- Current traffic expectation: initial pilot (MarJun): ~2030M tokens/month, scale to ~150200M/month within 912 months if pilot tests pass.
- Key evaluation criteria: latency (under 600ms p95), sustained throughput, and predictable unit economics.

Info we need to finalize a formal proposal:
1) Confirm target $/1M tokens you were expecting (ballpark is fine) so we can align discount tiers.
2) Budget range for the pilot and for year-1 committed spend (helps shape tiering / min commitment).
3) Timeline for procurement / PO / start date.

What we can offer (high-level):
- Startup program (eligibility-based): first-year credits/discounts (typically 3040% off hosted list pricing) + expedited onboarding support.
- Committed-use discounts (12/24 month terms): tiered pricing that materially reduces $/1M tokens as committed volume increases; multi-year locks give additional % off.
- Billing & PO friendly: monthly or quarterly invoicing, invoice-based billing for enterprise customers.

Next steps: if you can reply with the three items above (volumes, target $/1M, budget range), I'll put together a formal proposal with specific numbers and include an example cost calculator. I copied Dev (technical lead) and Aditya (pricing/ops) so they can weigh in if any special requirements or minimums are needed.

Thanks  talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference  Make LLM inference predictable and economical

From: Sam Carter <sam@acme-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo & pricing  startup / committed-use options

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the clear recap. A few answers and clarifications from our side: 

1) Volumes: for the pilot (next 3 months) we're planning for ~2030M tokens/month. If pilot goes well we're modeling 150200M tokens/month by month 912 once we expand to two additional product endpoints.
2) Target $/1M tokens: goal is in the $8$12 / 1M tokens range for production (that would make the unit economics work for us). For pilot we're comfortable at a slightly higher $/1M if we get credits or ramp discounts.
3) Budget: pilot budget is modest  $5k$15k/month depending on final $/1M. Year-1 committed budget we could consider is $120k$200k if pricing and SLA fit.

We are eligible for several startup programs (we raised seed Dec '25)  would be interested in seeing the startup tier. Also want to understand multi-year incentives: is there an incremental % for 24-month commits vs 12-month?

If you can send a proposal showing: (a) startup program terms, (b) 12-month committed tiers with examples for our projected volumes, and (c) a 24-month incentive line, that would be ideal. Once we have the proposal I'll loop in procurement and legal for timelines.

Cheers,
Sam
Co-founder & Head of Product | Acme Systems
sam@acme-systems.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-13T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo & pricing  startup / committed-use options

Thanks Sam  good context, that helps a lot. Attached is a formal proposal + a short token-cost calculator so you can swap in different volume curves. Below are the headline economics and examples mapped to your ranges.

Headline pricing (hosted API list price): $20 / 1M tokens (for reference)

Startup program (eligible companies / proof required):
- Typical: 3540% off list for year 1 + $10k onboarding credit for technical support and tuning.
- Example effective: ~$12 / 1M tokens during Year 1 (with 40% off).

Committed-use (hosted)  12-month term, billed monthly against commitment tiers:
- Tier A: 050M tokens/month => 20% off => $16 / 1M
- Tier B: 50200M tokens/month => 40% off => $12 / 1M
- Tier C: >200M tokens/month => 55% off => $9 / 1M

Multi-year incentive (24-month): additional 10% off the committed tier pricing (applies to both tiers above). Example: Tier B with 24mo => $10.8 / 1M.

Worked examples (your numbers):
- Pilot (2030M/month):
  - With startup program (40% off): ~$12 / 1M => $240$360 / month (for 2030M).
  - With Tier A committed (20% off): $16 / 1M => $320$480 / month.
- Scale (150200M/month):
  - Tier B (12mo, 40% off): $12 / 1M => $1,800$2,400 / month.
  - Tier B + 24mo incentive: $10.8 / 1M => $1,620$2,160 / month.

Notes and constraints:
- Minimum committed spend: for Tier B we require a 12-month minimum commitment that equals 50% of the monthly committed volume over the term (we can model this in the attached calculator if needed).
- Activation: startup discounts require eligibility docs (seed certificate or cap table), we can speed onboarding once verified.
- Custom SLAs/throughput guarantees and private deployments (VPC) are available under Dedicated/Private contracts  pricing differs.

I've attached: redwood_pricing_proposal_mar2026.pdf (formal quote), startup_program_terms.pdf, and token_cost_calculator.xlsx (editable). Dev and Aditya are cc'd  Dev, please confirm there are no infra caveats for the 200M/month sustained traffic; Aditya, flag any pricing/approval notes if we need an exception for deeper discounts or multi-year incentives.

If the numbers look reasonable I can: (1) lock a draft quote for 7 days, (2) get finance to generate a PO-friendly quote, and (3) schedule a quick procurement call next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pricing_proposal_mar2026.pdf, startup_program_terms.pdf, token_cost_calculator.xlsx

--
Marissa (on behalf of Redwood Inference)

Marissa  thanks for the quick turn. Proposal and calculator received and the examples are helpful. A few quick asks before we loop procurement: 

1) Can you show a 24-month illustrative schedule for 150M/month with the multi-year incentive applied (monthly spend and annualized total)?
2) Can you confirm the minimum committed spend language for Tier B (we'll need to confirm with finance that matches our forecasting).
3) Please send the sales-facing quote (PO-ready PDF) with payment and invoicing terms; our procurement wants net-30 and a standard PO flow.

If you can get the above by EOD Wednesday I'll have procurement on standby to move quickly. We're excited to get this live  want to target pilot kickoff mid-April.

Thanks  Sam
